definitions.explanation: The act of passing through or along a road, path, or area. Also refers to the traffic or flow of people and vehicles.

examples.english: This road has heavy vehicle traffic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's closed to traffic due to construction.
examples.notes: ⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧ = road closed, no passage

notes:
USAGE:
{通行|つうこう} is the passing of people or vehicles along a road, bridge, or passageway. It works as a noun and, with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, as a suru-verb. The register is official: it belongs to road signs, notices, and traffic reports. In conversation people use ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通行|つうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass along ~ (the ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marks the route travelled, not an object)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通行|つうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: there is heavy traffic on ~
- {通行|つうこう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ / {通行|つうこう}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: passable / closed to traffic

TRANSITIVITY:
{通行|つうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is intransitive. The ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ it can take is the particle of traversal, the same one in ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧, so it does not make the verb transitive.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧: road closed
- ⟦{通行人|つうこうにん}→通行人：28570_tsuukounin⟧: passerby
- ⟦{通行料|つうこうりょう}→通行料：14849_tsuukouryou⟧: toll
- ⟦{通行禁止|つうこうきんし}→通行禁止：24673_tsuukoukinshi⟧: no thoroughfare
- ⟦{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう}→一方通行：08949_ippoutsuukou⟧: one-way traffic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through — the everyday word
- ⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧: passing through without stopping
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧: traffic, transportation as a whole (noun only)
- ⟦{往来|おうらい}→往来：16044_ourai⟧: coming and going
